title: UNCOVERING COMPETENCY GAPS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS AND THEIR BENCHMARKS
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the analysis. The concept 'references to the divine or spiritual authority' was identified as a missed model gap for the Gemma2-2B-Instruct model, but this was not explored further.
